question: What is the basis of the "animal protein at least 48% of total protein" standard printed by the MOET, Ajinomoto and NIN menu software, is it a default or a hard check, and does the software food list include textured soy or other processed plant proteins?
why_it_matters: If it is a hard check or textured soy is absent, a plant ingredient cannot be written into software-built school menus; this decides whether DMV-17 is the first school move
cheapest_way_to_close: Written question to the NIN school nutrition team and the Ajinomoto School Meal Project; or a registered school account to inspect the menu bank
owner_org_to_ask: National Institute of Nutrition; Ajinomoto Vietnam; MOET Department of Students

question: What will the MOET circular on bán trú meal organisation (due 2026 under Decision 973/QĐ-TTg) say about menus, processed foods, supplier documents and menu software?
why_it_matters: It is the binding rule window for school meals in 2026 to 2027 and may restrict or admit processed plant proteins
cheapest_way_to_close: Watch the MOET draft-document portal and ask to join the consultation

question: What do school caterers pay per kg for tofu, pork, chicken, eggs and fish, and what share of a VND 35,000 to 40,000 meal is food?
why_it_matters: Replaces the retail-price budget in this line and fixes the TPP-04 school price target
cheapest_way_to_close: Cost sheets from three caterers (Hoa Sua, Ngoi Sao Xanh, Tu Anh)

question: Will primary pupils eat a textured-soy dish in the plant slot and a 20 to 30% blend in xíu mại or thịt viên, measured by plate waste?
why_it_matters: Decides whether schools become a second route for hybrids and whether the plant slot can take a new ingredient
cheapest_way_to_close: Two-week trial with one caterer that writes one menu for several schools, with ward approval
owner_org_to_ask: A Hanoi caterer and ward People's Committee

question: Do factory canteen menus hold tofu, chay or textured soy, and at what grams and cost per protein dish?
why_it_matters: Still the largest price-set channel; no published menus found (OQ-215 remains open)
cheapest_way_to_close: Menu and cost sheets from three caterers and two union committees

question: How common are tofu substitution and tofu menu versions in public hospital patient-meal tenders?
why_it_matters: Hospitals are a small, specification-led channel that already accepts tofu for meat
cheapest_way_to_close: Read ten tenders on public hospital websites and the national procurement portal

question: What protein foods and quantities make up the army ration under Circular 96/2025/TT-BQP?
why_it_matters: Completes the public-meal map; only the VND 72,000 allowance is known
owner_org_to_ask: Ministry of National Defence, General Department of Logistics

question: Do preschool menus (outside Decision 3958) serve more plant protein than primary menus?
why_it_matters: Preschools are a separate rule regime and a large meal count
cheapest_way_to_close: Audit 20 preschool weekly menus on the same school-site platforms
